cards.headline:
Bot protection turns away
Blend's AI shopping agent
cards.body: Bot protection stopped Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 of 200 retailers: 20% of large ones, 2.5% of emerging ones.

blocks.x: Blend's AI Shopping Audit, released with a findings statement on Nov 4, 2026, sent the company's AI shopping agent to 200 retailers. Bot protection turned the agent away at 29 of them.
Large retailers refused the agent at a 20% rate, while emerging retailers refused it at just 2.5%.

Yet all 24 refusers with a readable robots.txt file allow AI crawlers, which raises the question of who set those blocks. For merchants, the gap points to bot-protection settings rather than stated crawler policy as the thing to check before agentic shopping traffic arrives.
